scope: QuranEnc candidate assessment / Juz Amma source preparation for Qatra proof of concept

providerReview.check: One official documentation search and page-open attempt; page open returned HTTP 429 Too Many Requests.
providerReview.indexedDocumentationFinding: Search-indexed API documentation describes translations/list, translation/sura and translation/aya endpoints, including translation and footnotes fields. No Arabic-original-text endpoint was established by the retrieved documentation excerpt.
providerReview.exportFinding: Official home-page search excerpt lists Quran text PDF, EPUB, XML, CSV, Excel, SQLite database, and API among downloads. The excerpt does not identify a direct Arabic-original export/API schema or resolve whether the Arabic original is King Fahd lineage.
providerReview.rightsFinding: Search-indexed API page states re-publication conditions for translation content: no modification/addition/deletion, clear attribution to publisher and QuranEnc, version information, retain transcript/version information, report notes, update to new source versions, and avoid inappropriate ads. These stated terms are expressly for translations; permission for republishing Quran Arabic source text was not verified.
limitations: The official documentation and home pages returned HTTP 429 on direct open.
No API live lookup or export download was performed.
No Quran Arabic text is stored in this record or local acquisition folder.

nextEvidenceNeeded: Obtain provider's directly documented Arabic-original export/API route and inspect its metadata/schema.
Verify whether the Arabic text has documented King Fahd edition lineage and printed mushaf page identifiers; do not infer page mapping from ayah order.
Verify explicit rights for local storage, redistribution, and application display of Quran Arabic text.
If files are obtained later, record resolved URL, retrieval timestamp, bytes, SHA-256, schema/counts/ranges, and any published upstream checksum.
